name: Expeditions

categories.label: Coins ($)
categories.hint: All money you hold at the end (including money gained from melds, quests, items).

categories.label: Glory stars placed
categories.hint: About $10 per star placed with Boast (4 stars triggers the end; check rulebook).

categories.label: Vanquished Corruption tokens (face value)
categories.hint: Sum of printed values on your mech mat (tokens include 1, 2, 3 and one 20).

categories.label: Map tokens
categories.hint: Not confirmed as scoring for human players; enter count, counted as $0 unless rulebook says otherwise.

notes: family: coin-count. Score is money: coins + glory stars + vanquished corruption values (+ possibly items). Game ends when a player places their 4th glory star; each other player takes one final turn and the trigger player also gets a final turn. Official rulebook (Stonemaier Dropbox / BGG file 412199) could not be downloaded in this environment; values derived from publisher FAQ and BGG forum posts (star = $10 for players, $5 for Automa; corruption tokens by face value). Items, Gears of Corruption expansion and solo Automa scoring not modelled.
